evaluate_feature_bag: evaluate a single pickle file of video features and labels, aggregating clips per video and computing top-1 and top-5 accuracy
evaluate_dense_prediction: evaluate all pickle files in a directory, aggregating dense predictions per video and reporting aggregate top-1 and top-5 accuracy
run_cli_dense_prediction: run the dense prediction aggregation CLI tool with an input directory, optional clip accuracy output, and max clips per video
test_evaluate_feature_bag: test the evaluate_feature_bag function with a pickle file containing video_id, label, and softmax blob data
test_evaluate_dense_prediction: test the evaluate_dense_prediction function against a directory of pickle prediction files
